message:
release(0.2.117): a target for the in-app test, nothing else

Version constant only. Four binaries changed because the version is stamped into
them; ui/shell.html and the other five are byte-identical to 0.2.116, which is what a
version-only release should look like.

The installer's RT_RCDATA resources were read as bytes and hashed: nine of nine match
the build, and shell.html among them is 15,483 bytes -- the copy with the button.

Both gates pass, the served pair was fetched back and re-verified byte for byte, all
ten public URLs were downloaded anonymously and hashed, 0.2.116's artifacts were
compared on the server and are unchanged, and its manifest pair is backed up.

What publishing this does not do is make the test possible. The installed build here
is 0.2.114 and its shell.html has no update button, so 0.2.116 has to be installed by
hand first and the button pressed there. Installing 0.2.117 by hand would make the
installed version the newest one and leave nothing to update to, so no dist copy of
it was made.
